description: Election Commission - Declare that A. H. M. S. S. K. Abayarathna as a member of the Mawanella P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities elections.
